construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

input.feedback: array of {id: unique nonblank string, text: nonblank string}
input.knowledge_base: array of {id: unique nonblank string, title: nonblank string, text: nonblank string, keywords: string array}
input.questions: array of {id: unique nonblank string, text: nonblank string}

output.feedback_analysis: source_count, unique_count, duplicate_count, canonical groups, themes with exact source excerpts
output.support: team_online and responses with question IDs, status, grounded answer, citations, related themes, supporting feedback and optional human handoff

shared_schema.errors: One JSON object with status=error and error description; CLI exit 2
shared_schema.validation: Single validate(stage, value, context) layer; strict input keys/types, unique IDs per collection, <=1000 records per collection, <=100 keywords/article, <=10000 characters/string. Empty collections allowed. Validates deduplication coverage, counts, classification, exact evidence and deterministic support grounding. JSON duplicate keys and nonfinite constants rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.payload: Validated canonical groups, thematic summaries, original source IDs and exact-prefix supporting excerpts
cross_stage_handoffs.consumption: Support associates questions with feedback themes or shared meaningful terms, preserving deduplicated source provenance. These insights enrich each response but never substitute for authoritative knowledge-base guidance.

behavior.deduplication: NFKC Unicode normalization, case folding and word-token whitespace/punctuation normalization; first source is canonical. No fuzzy semantic deduplication.
behavior.themes: Deterministic English keyword categories delivery/refunds/product/support, with general fallback; multi-label counts may overlap.
behavior.excerpts: First 240 characters verbatim from canonical source; all duplicate source IDs retained.
behavior.support: General-purpose keyword-based knowledge-base retrieval; up to two exact published passages ranked by keyword overlap then article ID. No live AI or optional injected callable is needed.
behavior.offline: Guidance remains available offline. Unmatched questions request human assistance without fabricating a ticket, action or response time.
behavior.trust_boundary: Knowledge base is trusted published guidance; customer feedback is unverified evidence only. Grounded guidance is not a claim that an account action was performed.
behavior.determinism: Stable for identical input; no randomness, time dependence, network, model or external service.

excluded: Semantic reasoning or answer completeness guarantees

test_outcomes.verified: Unit suite and example CLI executed successfully; tests include subprocess success, usage and missing-file errors, plus in-memory malformed JSON fixtures.
